qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Incumbent Nordic network infrastructure and spectrum holdings are unreplicable, but wholesale open-access obligations and intense retail competition prevent earning excess returns, resulting in chronic 4-6% ROIC and real pricing erosion.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC 4-6% << 12%, negative real pricing power, REJECT). Swedish telecom incumbent suffers from chronic sub-hurdle capital returns, value-destructive media acquisitions (Bonnier Broadcasting/TV4), and inability to price above inflation amidst heavy 5G/fiber capital expenditure.
qualitative.evidence: Reported ROCE has languished between 4.8% and 6.9% across 2021-2024, with GAAP ROIC averaging ~4-6%, well below the 12% hurdle. High leverage with net debt/EBITDA >2.4x and repeated restructuring charges. Free cash flow generation is heavily absorbed by dividend commitments and infrastructure reinvestment.
